item.title: Dennis Haskins, beloved ‘Saved by the Bell’ star who played Mr. Belding, dead at 75
item.description: An image collage containing 3 images, Image 1 shows (From L-R) Ed Alonzo as Max, Dennis Haskins as Mr. Richard Belding, and Casey Kasem as himself in an episode of "Saved by the Bell.", Image 2 shows The cast and creator of NBC's "Saved by the Bell" at an NBC "Hot Shots" event, circa 1990. Back row, from left: Lark Voorhies, Mark-Paul Gosselaar, Mario Lopez and creator Sam Bobrick. Front row, from left: Tiffani Amber Thiessen, Elizabeth Berkley and Dennis Haskins, Image 3 shows Dennis Haskins, who played beloved principal Mr. Belding on "Saved by the Bell," has died at age 75
